section_path: Cornea, Retina, Choroid, Ciliary Body, Iris, Overlapping Lesion of Eye, and Other Eye (excluding Melanoma and Retinoblastoma)
text:
C691  Cornea, NOS
C692  Retina
C693  Choroid
C694  Ciliary body
C698  Overlapping lesion of eye and adnexa
C699  Eye, NOS

**Note 1:**  Laterality must be coded for this site.

**Note 2:** Melanomas and retinoblastomas are not included in this schema.

**Note 3:** TNM is not defined for this schema. If directly assigning Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000), use the *Cornea, Retina, Choroid, Ciliary Body* chapter on page 260 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=260).
